decks.title: ser or estar
decks.description: Choose and conjugate ser or estar in everyday sentences (A1–B1). The A1 part covers identity, origin, jobs, location, states and events; the A2 part adds the past tenses, estar + gerund and adjectives whose meaning changes with the verb.

decks.title: Stem-changing verbs
decks.description: e→ie, o→ue, e→i and u→ue in the present (A1–A2); the A2 part adds -ir verbs in the preterite and the gerund, and seguir in the imperative.

decks.title: Irregular preterites

decks.title: Verbs like gustar
decks.description: gustar, encantar, doler, quedar, apetecer (Spain) and faltar, where the thing is the subject (A2–B1). This A2 part covers the present and the past.

decks.title: por or para
